title: Ines and the Trail
author: Vesper Hartwell
blurb: Mirabel Montrose, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
